name: Leela Palace Hotel New Delhi
insider_take: This opulent palace sits in the heart of Diplomatic Enclave, where world leaders and royalty have walked these marble halls since 2011.
whats_special: The Leela Palace is built with over 9 different types of rare marble and features hand-painted frescoes inspired by Rajasthani miniature art. The hotel's Royal Club Butler service is legendary among Delhi's luxury properties, and the rooftop infinity pool offers stunning views of the nearby Lodhi Gardens' 15th-century tombs.
pro_tip: Book the Library Bar during sunset hours - it's housed in a stunning atrium with floor-to-ceiling windows and serves Delhi's most exclusive whiskey collection while overlooking the city's green belt.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature Spa by ESPA features treatments using 24-karat gold, and Jamavar restaurant serves royal recipes once prepared for Indian maharajas. Take an evening stroll to nearby India Gate (10 minutes away) - it's beautifully illuminated and less crowded after dark.
pros: Palatial luxury with opulent Indian architecture and royal ambiance
Prime location in Diplomatic Enclave near government district
Award-winning spa and world-class dining restaurants
Exceptional personalized service with high staff-to-guest ratio
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects ultra-high-end positioning
Formal atmosphere may feel overly elaborate for casual travelers
